text: E haawnu on fii waaju arii on immorde ka Joomi mon e dow gorko jeyaaɗo e mo'on, mo jeyaaka e Malaa'ika maa jinna, fii yo o jertin on?! Annditee Joomi mon yetton Mo e neemaaji Makko ɗin ka hoore leydi, e ko O waɗiri on kon lontiiɓe yimɓe Nuuhu halkanooɓe ɓen fii ko ɓe yeddiri kon, yetton Alla ko O ɓeydiri on ceembe e doole, jantoɗon neemaaji Alla ɗin belajo'o, on malete.
